scripts.start: node -e "const http=require('http'), fs=require('fs'), path=require('path'); http.createServer((req,res)=>{ let f=req.url==='/'?'index.html':req.url.slice(1); if(fs.existsSync(f)){ res.writeHead(200); fs.createReadStream(f).pipe(res); } else { res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not found'); } }).listen(8080, ()=>console.log('Listening on http://localhost:8080'));"
